notes: ProCompNav answers checked against the target photo (long low cabinet with a weathered multicolor plank front, beside a bed with a lavender spread, louvered closet door behind it; c4 view 2 shows it at the foot of the bed): (1) arched panel doors = No: plain plank front, no arches. (2) wooden table beside = No: a bed is beside it, no table. Truth table follows the log's pruning exactly ([c2,c3,c4] then [c4]). c0 and c1 are two detections of the same white basement kitchenette with arched-panel doors; the round wooden dining table stands right in front of it in their views, so both are labeled 'wooden table beside'. c2 = yellow-topped console by the stairs with round wooden coffee tables in front and a sofa beside it; c3 = black nightstand next to the round wooden dining table and the sliding glass door.
